title: [Bug] The --guided instructions use an outdated wren memory recall option
body:
## Bug: `wren ask --guided` uses outdated memory commands

### Environment

- WrenAI version: 0.13.0
- Operating system: Windows
- Command: `wren ask "test" --guided`

### Description

When running `wren ask "test" --guided`, the generated guide contains the following instruction:
wren memory recall --nl "<keywords>"
However, the current wren memory recall command accepts --query or -q. The --nl option belongs to wren memory store.

As a result, following the generated guide causes the command to fail because --nl is not a valid option for wren memory recall.
The guided workflow also does not mention wren memory fetch, even though the current CLI provides this command for retrieving schema context:
wren memory fetch --query "<question>"

Expected behavior
The guided instructions should use the current command syntax:
wren memory recall --query "<keywords>"
# or
wren memory recall -q "<keywords>"

wren memory fetch --query "<question>"
Please update the guided template so that it stays synchronized with the current CLI commands and documentation. It would also be helpful to add a regression test to prevent future mismatches between the generated guide and the CLI options.
References
https://github.com/Canner/WrenAI/blob/main/core/wren/src/wren/ask_templates/guided.md.tmpl
https://github.com/Canner/WrenAI/blob/main/core/wren/src/wren/memory/cli.py
https://github.com/Canner/WrenAI/blob/main/core/wren/docs/cli.md

linked_prs.title: fix(ask): guided template's recall step uses a valid CLI option
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/core/wren/src/wren/ask_templates/guided.md.tmpl b/core/wren/src/wren/ask_templates/guided.md.tmpl
index 5651379540..f0b1eba16a 100644
--- a/core/wren/src/wren/ask_templates/guided.md.tmpl
+++ b/core/wren/src/wren/ask_templates/guided.md.tmpl
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ Identify the task type, then follow the matching flow:
 
 TASK TYPE A — data question:
   1. wren context show [--path <project>]   # see MDL models
-  2. wren memory recall --nl "<keywords>"   # similar past queries (skip if no memory)
+  2. wren memory recall -q "<keywords>"  # similar past queries (skip if no memory)
   3. write SQL using model names (not raw tables)
   4. wren dry-plan --sql '...'              # validate non-trivial SQL
   5. wren query --sql '...'                 # execute
diff --git a/core/wren/tests/unit/test_ask_cli.py b/core/wren/tests/unit/test_ask_cli.py
index a2019d9852..ff14cb176f 100644
--- a/core/wren/tests/unit/test_ask_cli.py
+++ b/core/wren/tests/unit/test_ask_cli.py
@@ -58,6 +58,24 @@ def test_render_unknown_mode_raises():
         ask_mod.render("auto", "anything")
 
 
+def test_guided_recall_step_uses_a_real_cli_option():
+    # The guided template's step 2 must emit an option `wren memory recall`
+    # actually accepts. Regression for #2503: the template said `--nl`, an
+    # option that belongs to `wren memory store`, not `recall`.
+    result = runner.invoke(app, ["ask", "x", "--guided"])
+    assert "--nl" not in result.output
+
+    recall_line = next(
+        line for line in result.output.splitlines() if "wren memory recall" in line
+    )
+    args = recall_line.split("wren memory recall", 1)[1].split("#", 1)[0].split()
+    recall_result = runner.invoke(app, ["memory", "recall", *args])
+    # A bad option is a click usage error (exit code 2, "No such option").
+    # Any other exit code means the option parsed and the command moved on
+    # to its own logic (e.g. failing later for lacking a wren project).
+    assert recall_result.exit_code != 2, recall_result.output
+
+
 def test_user_prompt_with_template_placeholder_substring_is_safe():
     # Prompt containing the literal placeholder shouldn't break rendering;
     # we only do one replacement of the bundled-template placeholder.
